If March continues at a similar rate, reaching 900 by the end of March is plausible, and calibration assigns a 96% posterior probability, acknowledging uncertainty from volatility and potential underreporting.
summary: 606 deaths by late February 2026 indicate an unusually high start to the year.
If March maintains the February pace (roughly 300 deaths), end-March total could reach or exceed 900.
Historical annual tolls (roughly 2,000–2,500) make a 900-end-March figure plausible but not guaranteed.
Bayesian calibration yields a posterior probability of 96% with correlated factors.
